cases.name: Erika Megan Sharpton
cases.about: She was a nursing student who worked her way through school as a waitress and nursing aide and was two months from graduating. Her obituary said, "She was a compassionate, caring soul, and planned a career in nursing."
cases.narrative: Her body was found on fire on the side of the road. She was nude from the waist down and the fire was concentrated on her pelvic region. Detective Todd Hindman said you could actually see broken bones in her skull.
